name: 97759 · Sisters, OR
findings: ZIP 97759 (Sisters) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97759 (Sisters) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
